But I won’t act like nothing happened, I take the blame and will try to fix this.

I apologize for doing this. Will never do such thing ever again.

statuses.text:
Just reached $10k/mo as a 17y/o designer

Here is my life story.

Everything started when I was 15.

I knew absolutely nothing about business.

And I wanted to become a millionaire,

That's what boys at some point of their life all want to be,

And finally start taking life seriously, not living on auto-pilot.

For me that happened early.

So I picked a niche I found the most fun:

 I loved art, but I also loved computers.

The mix of them? 

Websites. Espeacially design.

And so I sat down every single day for the past 2 years.

Learning how to design and develop websites.

Not even a single day I stopped believing in myself, that I will make it someday.

And that drive is the secret on how I got here:

- Designed a lot, every single day
- Learned a lot, every single day
- Worked a lot, every single day

Just outwork others by being consistent.

Have passion and love in what you do.

And never ever stop doing it. 

At the start you won't understand shit,

But if you just do what you know and can today - you'll end up unlocking the knowledge to the next steps,

In order to reach $10k, $100k, $1M...

The moral of the story?

Is that I'm no different from you.

Just work harder bro.
